points.description: Correct two-state model with both equations: x1 = θ, x2 = θ̇ (or equivalent state choice), ẋ1 = x2 and ẋ2 = (1/J)(τ − b x2 − mgℓ sin x1). Both equations needed; a correct equivalent state choice is accepted. Numerical values may be substituted (1/J = 50, b/J = 2.5, mgℓ/J = 122.625).

Equilibrium condition mgℓ sin θe = τ0 (with x2 = 0) AND the existence range |τ0| ≤ mgℓ = 2.4525 N·m. Full mark needs the evaluated number with the modulus (or symmetry stated anywhere, e.g. −2.4525 ≤ τ0 ≤ 2.4525). Equilibrium equation without any range earns 0. Range given only symbolically as |τ0| ≤ mgℓ without evaluating earns 0 (marks are whole numbers). Range without the modulus and no mention of symmetry earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full marks: P1 needs both state equations correct; P2 needs the equilibrium equation plus the evaluated range with modulus (or symmetry). Because marks are in whole steps, a missing range, an unevaluated symbolic range, or a range without modulus/symmetry gives 0 for P2. Not mentioning two equilibria is not penalised.
rubric.answer_key: States x1 = θ, x2 = θ̇: ẋ1 = x2; ẋ2 = (1/J)(τ − b x2 − mgℓ sin x1). Equilibrium: ẋ1 = 0 gives x2 = 0; ẋ2 = 0 gives mgℓ sin θe = τ0, with mgℓ = 1×9.81×0.25 = 2.4525 N·m. Since |sin θe| ≤ 1, an equilibrium exists only if |τ0| ≤ 2.4525 N·m (two equilibria per admissible τ0 inside the range, not required).
